reasoning_details.text:
I'm checking the five points in turn: the 30k, 40k and 10k call-offs sum to 80k, which holds if the ledger is complete. The 90k figure doesn't hold. Reaching 80k doesn't trigger F02, and F03's cancellations don't count as zero. Z belongs to FW-B, not the framework F01 totals, so that one is doubtful.

I'm treating P08 as contradicted, since the current-quarter total only counts call-offs dated in this quarter, and a previous-quarter call-off falls outside F01's scope. P06 is different: the records don't say how merges are handled, so I can't settle it either way. P07 holds because F03 supports it.
